_comment: Measured once from the sample videos and reviewed by hand. Positions are normalised to frame width and height so they survive a change of fixture scale. Tolerances in eval.test.ts are deliberately wide: the question is whether detection lands on the right platform, not whether it reproduces a number exactly.

test51._note: Platform sits noticeably left of frame centre, about 35 px off at 640 wide. This is the clip that exercises off-centre handling.

test53._note: Recorded at 29.93 fps against test51's 15.0 fps. Same rig, same assay, different frame rate, which is why the tool never assumes one.
